# EurekAlert!

> > EurekAlert! is a science news platform providing advanced search and discovery of research releases across multiple institutions and disciplines.

EurekAlert! serves as a comprehensive database and search interface for science news releases, enabling researchers, journalists, and the public to discover and filter research announcements by topic, institution, and research area. The platform emphasizes content discovery through advanced search capabilities and organized tag categories.

## Key Topics

- advanced-search
- science-news
- research-releases
- search-interface
- content-filtering
- tag-categories
- research-database
- news-discovery
- institutional-research
- scientific-announcements

## Search & Discovery

- [Advanced Search Interface](https://www.eurekalert.org/advancedSearch): Advanced search interface for filtering and discovering science news releases by topic, institution, date range, and research category
